First, note the date format: 04-02-1405 likely means DD-MM-YYYY → 4 February 1405.  
240 days before 4 February 1405:  

1404 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
Going back:  
From 4 Feb 1405 → 4 Jan 1405 = 31 days back (31 total)  
From 4 Jan 1405 → 4 Dec 1404 = 31 days (62 total)  
From 4 Dec 1404 → 4 Nov 1404 = 30 days (92 total)  
From 4 Nov 1404 → 4 Oct 1404 = 31 days (123 total)  
From 4 Oct 1404 → 4 Sep 1404 = 30 days (153 total)  
From 4 Sep 1404 → 4 Aug 1404 = 31 days (184 total)  
From 4 Aug 1404 → 4 Jul 1404 = 31 days (215 total)  
Need 240 days back, so 240 - 215 = 25 more days before 4 Jul 1404.  

June 1404 has 30 days:  
4 Jul → 4 Jun is 30 days, but we only need 25 days before 4 Jul:  
4 Jul back 25 days = 4 Jul → 3 Jul (1), to 2 Jul (2), … down to 9 Jun (25 days before 4 Jul).  

Check: June 9, 1404.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-06-09
